title: Compactness of Cone Yang-Mills Connections
summary: We consider the cone Yang-Mills functional recently introduced by Tseng and Zhou. This functional generalizes the Yang-Mills functional by coupling it to a closed 2-form which can represent a geometric structure of interest, e.g. a symplectic form or Ricci form. While the perspective of dimensional reduction is not always possible, we show that a cone Yang-Mills field is always locally the dimensional reduction of a pure Yang-Mills field.
